description: Tetrahydrothiophene (THT) concentration distribution dataset in urban gas network: simulation and field monitoring data for point selection optimization Tetrahydrothiophene (THT) concentration distribution dataset in urb is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Yifan Jiang, Ge Liang (Southwest Petroleum University). This dataset comprises simulation and field measurement data regarding the dispersion of Tetrahydrothiophene (THT), a common odorant in natural gas, within urban gas distribution networks. The data supports the optimization of monitoring point placement and leakage detection strategies. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 20218 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
